description: Sends plain text or ChordPro (pasted lyrics and chords, no file) to the Jam Jam API, waits for the conversion to finish, and returns the result: embedded text for small text formats, or a local file path for binary formats (PDF, MIDI...). Call jj_list_formats first to find valid "output" ids. Consumes one unit of the conversion quota.

deliver.description: "download" (default) returns the artifact; "carnet" saves it to the caller's Jam Jam notebook instead (requires an account).

inputFormat.description: Input format id from jj_list_formats (e.g. "chordpro", "text-lyrics"). Omit to let the server detect it.

maxWaitMs.description: Maximum time to wait for the job to finish, in milliseconds (default 120000, hard cap 600000). If exceeded, the job keeps running server-side; poll it with jj_get_job.

options.description: Extra per-format options, see jj_list_formats for the target format.

text.description: Plain text or ChordPro to convert (up to 262144 characters).

name: jj_convert_text
title: Convert pasted text or ChordPro
